fragments.before:
Need help choosing?

Tell us what is happening.

Include the address or suburb, whether it is plumbing or electrical, what you can observe and any access details.

Ready to request a repair?

Send your suburb and repair details. Our Perth team arranges an on-site assessment and confirms the repair plan and written quote.

Request a repair

Choose the property location, then the service

The six regional guides organise the existing Perth suburb directory. They do not represent six separate shopfronts or confirm a dispatch time. Pair the address with the actual repair request so access, scope and availability can be checked together. Mandurah and Peel are not automatically included by the research table; ask about an address outside the listed directory.

  • Find the plumbing service
  • Find the electrical service
  • Confirm an address and proposed work
Does selecting a suburb confirm an appointment?

No. A suburb link prefills the property field in the enquiry form. The team still needs to agree the visit, work scope and access with you.

Is there a local office in every listed suburb?

No. A service-area listing is a way to organise enquiries, not a claim that Ellis has premises in each suburb. The Perth office and its contact details are listed separately.
